answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks through hydrodynamic attestation. Each node pairs a hardware trust anchor with an ultrasonic flow probe mounted on a coastal jetty. A secure operating system kernel signs continuous turbulence telemetry, forcing an attacker to fabricate and submerge discrete marine sensor packages rather than running virtualized nodes. However, biofouling from algae accumulation can attenuate acoustic signals, spuriously invalidating honest agents.
